entries.instructions: Trang chủ. Use Hệ thống văn bản, Công báo, văn bản/tra cứu and newest issuances. Search by số ký hiệu, issuer and subject, open the law/decree/circular and all annexes, checking ngày ban hành separately from ngày có hiệu lực and amendments/replacements. Compare regional minimum wages, reference salary, social/health/unemployment insurance classes, tax relief/bands, union dues, leave and holidays. A đề xuất/recommendation is not a final rule. Open this public portal directly; use its navigation/site search and follow official document links. Record the exact document URL, issuer, instrument number, publication/effective dates, quoted clause/table and relevant scope for each proposed change. Read all relevant annexes and amendments; if a PDF is scanned, inspect/OCR the original pages and verify figures visually. Use another registered official portal if a page is inaccessible, and report unresolved evidence instead of guessing. Never sign in, upload customer records, or treat a press summary as the full operative instrument.

sources.instructions: Compare the complete jurisdiction snapshot against operative, published official law. Specific document URLs are evidence citations, not source registry entries. Apply each entry's own extraction guidance.

change_summary: The law in force on 1 December 2025: SI 8%/17.5% and HI 1.5%/3% on the 20 × 2,340,000 = 46,800,000 cap (Law 41/2024, Decree 188/2025); unemployment insurance 1%/1% on 20 regional minimum wages (Decree 74/2024, Region I 4,960,000); the 2% union fee; and the seven-rung PIT scale with the Resolution 954/2020 deductions of 132,000,000 and 52,800,000.

employment_type.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.20: PERMANENT is an indefinite-term contract, CONTRACT a fixed term of at most 36 months; PROBATION (art.24–27), PART_TIME (art.32), INTERN (art.61) and DOMESTIC (art.161, outside unemployment insurance). SERVICE: paid without a labour contract (a service or casual engagement): PIT 10% on payments at the threshold (Circular 111/2013 art.25(1)(i); Decree 253/2026 art.50(2)).

work_classification.description: Labour Code art.113(1): 12 days of annual leave for ordinary work, 14 for heavy, hazardous or dangerous (ARDUOUS) and 16 for especially heavy, hazardous or dangerous work.

residency_status.description: CITIZEN: a Vietnamese citizen resident for PIT (also in unemployment insurance). PERMANENT_RESIDENT: a foreigner with a permanent residence card (PIT resident). RESIDENT: another foreigner resident for PIT (183 days in the year or a home for 183 days). NON_RESIDENT: taxed at 20% with no deductions. PIT refuses any other value: the law presumes neither.

prior_floor_region.title: Worksite region on 31 December 2025
prior_floor_region.description: Decree 293/2025 art.5(5): the worksite's minimum-wage region under the prior order, read for an incumbent whose area was reclassified lower.

prior_floor_reclassified.title: Area reclassified lower in 2026
prior_floor_reclassified.description: True only when the same worksite was assigned a lower 2026 region by the decree.

probation_class.title: Probation job class (Labour Code art.25)
probation_class.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.25: probation at most 180 days for an enterprise manager (Law on Enterprises, Law on State Capital), 60 days for a job needing college-level or higher qualifications, 30 days for intermediate-level, technical-worker or clerical jobs, 6 working days for any other job. Record it on probation terms.

probation_job_wage.title: Wage of the job on probation
probation_job_wage.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.26: the probation wage is at least 85% of the wage of that job. Record the job’s agreed wage on probation terms.

normal_hours_arrangement.title: Normal working-time arrangement
normal_hours_arrangement.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.105(1)–(2): daily arrangement allows at most eight normal hours a day; weekly arrangement allows at most ten, both at most 48 a week. Unrecorded arrangement defaults to DAILY.

normal_hours_notified_on.title: Working-time arrangement notified on
normal_hours_notified_on.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.105(2): record when the worker was notified of the selected daily or weekly arrangement. A date records the notification; retain delivery evidence separately.

pass_type.title: Work-permit basis
pass_type.description: INTRA_COMPANY_TRANSFER is outside compulsory SI (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2(2)).

net_of_tax.title: Net-of-tax salary
net_of_tax.description: The employer bears the PIT: the tax is grossed up on the converted income (Circular 111/2013 art.7, Annex 02).

hourly_rate.title: Hourly rate (hourly-paid terms)
hourly_rate.description: Checked against the regional hourly minimum wage (Decree 293/2025 art.3(2)).

minor_listed_job.title: A job listed for minors’ overtime and night work

work_permit_valid_until.title: Work permit valid until
work_permit_valid_until.description: A foreign employee's work permit expiry (Decree 219/2025/NĐ-CP art.21: at most two years). Raises the extension task 45 days before it (art.28(1)) and the permit return on exit (art.31(1)).

annual_leave_combined.title: Annual leave combined across years (agreed)
annual_leave_combined.description: Labour Code 2019 art.113(4): the employee and employer agreed to combine annual leave over up to three years. The unused days of the two previous calendar years carry in (carry_depth 2); days older than that lapse.

child_arts_sports_approved.title: Under-13 arts or sports work approved
child_arts_sports_approved.description: Labour Code 2019 art.145(3): a child under 13 works only in arts, physical training or sports work with the provincial labour authority’s consent; true records that consent.

contract_type.title: Labour contract type
contract_type.description: Labour Code 2019 art.20(1): an indefinite-term contract (INDEFINITE) or a fixed-term one of at most 36 months (FIXED, record agreed_term_months). The 10% PIT on contracts under three months and the SI coverage of contracts under one month (twelve for foreigners) read the agreed term, not the exit date; with neither fact recorded the months from start to exit stand in.

agreed_term_months.title: Agreed contract term (months)
agreed_term_months.description: The term the fixed-term labour contract states, in months (Labour Code art.20(1)(b)): Circular 111/2013 art.25(1)(i) / Decree 253/2026 art.50(2) (10% PIT under three months), Law 41/2024 art.2(1)(a) (SI from one month) and art.2(2) (a foreign employee from twelve months).

special_role_notice.title: Special-role notice period
special_role_notice.description: Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.7 (Labour Code arts.35(1)(d), 36(2)(d)): an aircrew member, aircraft or aviation equipment maintenance staff, flight dispatcher, enterprise manager (Law on Enterprises; Law on State capital), ship crew working abroad or a seafarer on a Vietnamese ship abroad. Notice is at least 120 days for an indefinite or 12-month-plus contract and a quarter of the term for a shorter one.

receiving_pension.description: A worker already receiving a retirement pension: outside compulsory social, health-by-employer and unemployment insurance (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2), so the SI-equivalent allowance is paid instead.

disabled.description: A person with a disability: fourteen days of annual leave (Labour Code 2019 art.113(1)) and the disabled new-hire unemployment-insurance relief.

fixed_term.description: A fixed-term contract: while true the employment is not permanent (`permanent_when`).

pension_eligible.title: Qualifies for a pension on leaving
pension_eligible.description: Labour Code 2019 art.46(1): no severance allowance where the employee qualifies for a pension under the social insurance law (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.64).

absent_five_days.title: Dismissed for five days' unexcused absence
absent_five_days.description: Labour Code 2019 art.36(1)(e): the employer ended the contract after five consecutive working days absent without good reason; art.46(1) owes no severance allowance.

final_settlement_extended.title: Settlement period extended to 30 days
final_settlement_extended.description: Labour Code 2019 art.48(1): settlement within 14 working days of termination; only art.48(1)(a), (c), (d) — the employer ceased operating; a merger, division, sale or transfer; natural disaster, fire, enemy action or epidemic — allow up to 30 days. Unrecorded is the 14-day rule.

unlawful_resignation.title: Left unlawfully
unlawful_resignation.description: Labour Code art.40: a worker who ended the contract unlawfully gets no severance and owes half a month’s wage and the unserved notice.

long_illness.title: Ended for a long illness
long_illness.description: Labour Code 2019 art.36(1)(b): the employer ended the contract because the employee stayed unable to work after the treatment period (12 months indefinite, 6 months fixed term, half the term under 12 months); art.36(2)(c) needs only 3 working days’ notice, whatever the contract term.

exit_facts.description: Stored on employment_contract.exit_facts when the contract closes.

kind.description: The standing in the scheme, e.g. MEMBER or EXEMPT.

reference_number.description: The scheme registration number (SI book number, tax code).

union_member.title: Trade union member
union_member.description: UNION_DUES standing: a member pays 0.5% of the insurance salary, at most 10% of the reference level (Law 50/2024 art.29(1)(a); Decision 61/QĐ-TLĐ).

dependants.title: Registered dependants
dependants.description: PIT standing: each dependant registered with the tax authority is a monthly family deduction of 4,400,000 (Resolution 954/2020).

finalisation_authorised.title: Authorises the employer PIT finalisation
finalisation_authorised.description: PIT standing: the employer finalises the year only for an employee who authorised it (Decree 126/2020 art.8(6)(d); Decree 253/2026 art.51 from 2026).

unpaid_leave_continuation.title: SI continued through unpaid leave by agreement
unpaid_leave_continuation.description: SI standing: the parties agreed to keep paying compulsory SI for a month with 14 or more unpaid working days (Law 41/2024/QH15 arts.33(5), 34(3)). Unrecorded is the exemption.

si_treaty_exempt.title: Exempt from Vietnamese SI by treaty
si_treaty_exempt.description: SI standing: a foreign employee an international agreement Vietnam is party to exempts (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2(2)).

pension_qualified.title: Already qualifies for a pension
pension_qualified.description: UI standing: an employee who qualifies for a pension is outside unemployment insurance (Law 74/2025/QH15 art.31(2)).

commitment_form.title: Commitment form 08/CK-TNCN filed
commitment_form.description: PIT standing: a resident with no contract or one under three months who expects no taxable income after the family deduction files form 02/CK-TNCN; the 10% withholding is suspended (Circular 111/2013/TT-BTC art.25(1)(i)).

voluntary_pension_contribution.title: Voluntary pension / life-insurance contribution (VND a month)
voluntary_pension_contribution.description: PIT standing: the employee’s own monthly contribution to voluntary pension, deducted with the employer’s up to 1,000,000 a month (Circular 111/2013/TT-BTC art.9(2)(c)).

facts.description: Person facts: the other keys of employment_profile.facts (CEL employee.facts.*).

si_contribution_years.title: Years of social-insurance contribution
si_contribution_years.description: SICK_LEAVE: 30 working days a year under 15 years of compulsory SI contribution, 40 from 15 to under 30, 60 from 30 — 10 more for arduous or especially arduous work (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.43(1)). Unrecorded meters the 60-day band, so no lawful day is refused.

si_number.title: Social insurance number (mã số BHXH)
si_number.description: The participant’s VSS social insurance number, D02-LT column 1. Leave it unrecorded for a first registration: VSS issues it. Quyết định 366/QĐ-BHXH ngày 29/4/2026, mẫu D02-LT and its guide (https://baohiemxahoi.gov.vn/vanban/Pages/default.aspx?ItemID=5018)

hi_registered_facility.title: Initial health-care facility (nơi đăng ký KCB ban đầu)
hi_registered_facility.description: The facility the participant chose for initial health-insurance treatment, D02-LT column 16 on a registration. Quyết định 366/QĐ-BHXH ngày 29/4/2026, mẫu D02-LT and its guide (https://baohiemxahoi.gov.vn/vanban/Pages/default.aspx?ItemID=5018)

overtime_300h_sector.title: Eligible for 300 annual overtime hours
overtime_300h_sector.description: Labour Code 2019 art.107(2)(b): at most 200 overtime hours a year; art.107(3) allows 300 only in the listed sectors and cases (Decree 145/2020 art.61), and art.107(4) only after notifying the provincial labour authority. Unrecorded is the general 200-hour limit.

rest_averaged_monthly.title: Rest averaged monthly
rest_averaged_monthly.description: Labour Code 2019 art.111(1): at least 24 consecutive hours of rest each week; only where the work cycle cannot allow weekly rest may the employer average it to at least four days a month. Unrecorded is the weekly rule.

occupational_accident_reduced.title: Approved reduced occupational accident rate
occupational_accident_reduced.description: Decree 58/2020/NĐ-CP art.4(1): the occupational accident and disease fund rate is 0.5% of the salary; the reduced 0.3% applies only to an employer the Ministry approved on application (art.4(1)(b), art.5). Unrecorded is the 0.5% rate.

pit_quarterly_filer.title: Declares salary PIT quarterly (quarterly VAT filer)
pit_quarterly_filer.description: Law on Tax Administration 38/2019/QH14 art.44(1)(a)–(b) with Decree 126/2020/NĐ-CP arts.8(1), 9: a payer eligible to declare VAT quarterly may declare salary PIT quarterly; unrecorded is the monthly return by the 20th. From 1 July 2026 (Circular 89/2026/TT-BTC art.22(1)(a)(a.1)) every salary payer declares quarterly and this input is not read.

stoppage_pay_percent.title: Agreed stoppage pay (% of the contract wage)
stoppage_pay_percent.description: Labour Code 2019 art.99(2)–(3): for a stoppage caused by a co-worker or an objective cause the parties agree the stoppage wage, not below the regional minimum wage (for a longer stoppage, the first 14 working days). STOPPAGE_REDUCTION deducts the difference between the contract day wage and the larger of this share and the regional minimum day wage (company.region). Unrecorded is full pay.

six_monthly_health_checks.title: Six-monthly health checks
six_monthly_health_checks.description: Law on Occupational Safety and Hygiene 84/2015/QH13 art.21(1): health checks at least once a year, every six months for heavy, hazardous or dangerous work, minors, the disabled and the elderly. Set when the entity employs any of them; unrecorded raises the yearly check only.

vss_unit_code.title: Vietnam Social Security unit code
vss_unit_code.description: The employer’s SI/HI/UI unit code (mã đơn vị) with Vietnam Social Security (Law 41/2024 art.28).

tax_code.title: Enterprise tax code
tax_code.description: The employer’s tax identification number for PIT withholding returns.

state_owned_enterprise.title: State-owned enterprise
state_owned_enterprise.description: UNION_DUES: in a State enterprise members pay 0.5% of the take-home salary after SI, HI, UI and PIT, at most 10% of the base salary (Decision 61/QĐ-TLĐ); elsewhere 0.5% of the SI salary.

work_expense_limit.title: Monthly work-expense allowance limit (internal rules)
work_expense_limit.description: PIT: phone, stationery, travel and work-clothing allowances are taxable only above this level (Decree 253/2026 art.8(2)(đ)). Unrecorded is 0: the whole allowance is taxable.

vss_result_delivery.title: VSS result delivery (hình thức nhận kết quả)
vss_result_delivery.description: How the unit receives VSS results (bản điện tử or bản giấy), D02-LT column 17; the guide requires it on an exit, retirement or transfer. Unrecorded leaves the column empty. Quyết định 366/QĐ-BHXH ngày 29/4/2026, mẫu D02-LT and its guide (https://baohiemxahoi.gov.vn/vanban/Pages/default.aspx?ItemID=5018)
